The '''PDS2 interviews''' are a series of ''Star Wars'' CCG videos by [[Bill Bisco]] on his YouTube channel BillBisco2, published from March 2025.<ref name="yt-2m64vE4jCFw" /> Most episodes pair a player interview with deck techs and sample games in the PDS2 (Premiere to Death Star II) retro format played on [[GEMP]] and in the [[Retro League]]. The channel also carries tournament finals, format overviews and history videos. It has about 60 videos.

== Interviews ==

Interview guests include World Champions [[Hayes Hunter]] (2023),<ref name="yt-qJuistFFk9M" /> [[Joe Olson]] (2020, 2021, 2024)<ref name="yt-A-yqKSMt6gE" /> and [[Matt Sokol]] (2000),<ref name="yt-jFXqTc1jkNc" /> four-time Worlds finalist [[Paul Todd Feldman]] (DRTORCH),<ref name="yt-b9f9tNBiU2I" /> Players Committee designer [[Ryan Jellison]],<ref name="yt-gMDU9Klq2gA" /> [[Jonny Chu]]<ref name="yt-JLkMOP3rLQ8" /> and [[Brad Kippel]].<ref name="yt-wnrvWRn6r_c" />

== History videos ==

* ''LOTR TCG & SWCCG: A Brief History of GEMP'' – the history of the [[GEMP]] online client.<ref name="yt-Iogj7fiwSE8" />
* ''SWCCG: A Path Unlike Any Other, The MTG and Chess Influences Behind a Gaming Icon''.<ref name="yt-_WArG6IN520" />
* ''Magic the Gathering's Influence on CCG Standards''.<ref name="yt-XPTBO-m915Q" />
